import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';

/**
 * Options for a client.
 *
 * Every field is optional.
 */
export interface ClientOptions<T = unknown> extends Base {
  readonly baseUrl?: string;
  readonly extra?: T;
}

/** A user id. */
export type UserId = string & { readonly brand: 'UserId' };

export const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS: number = 5_000;

const internalRetries = 3,
  internalDelay = 10;

/**
 * Creates a client.
 * @param options - how to connect
 */
export function createClient(
  options: ClientOptions,
  retries = internalRetries,
): Client {
  return new Client(options, retries);
}

export async function* pages<T>(fetchPage: (n: number) => Promise<T[]>): AsyncGenerator<T> {
  yield* await fetchPage(0);
}

/** Talks to the API. */
export class Client extends EventEmitter {
  #secret = '';

  constructor(
    private readonly options: ClientOptions,
    readonly retries: number,
  ) {
    super();
  }

  /** Lists users. */
  async listUsers(limit?: number): Promise<UserId[]> {
    return [];
  }

  private sign(body: string): string {
    return body + this.#secret;
  }

  protected guard(): void {}

  static create(): Client {
    return new Client({}, 0);
  }
}

export abstract class Store {
  abstract get(key: string): Promise<string | undefined>;
}

export enum Role {
  Admin = 'admin',
  Member = 'member',
}

export const toId = (value: string): UserId => value as UserId;

function helper(): void {}

export { helper };

export function overloaded(value: string): string;
export function overloaded(value: number): number;
export function overloaded(value: string | number): string | number {
  return value;
}

export default function main(): void {}

declare function ambient(name: string): void;

let notConst = 1;
